title: Publisher
description: The party that publishes content: an upstream project or a first-party owner. Identity and trust only — fetch coordinates belong to Package.spec.source, because one Publisher may ship from several repositories. V1 note: no field under spec is read by the resolver — the Publisher is loaded, existence-checked, and otherwise inert. Fields are therefore permitted but not required, and their shape follows the shipped catalog rather than catalog-spec.md:387-433, which ADR 0011 supersedes.

repository.description: Informational link only. It never defines fetch identity — that lives in Package.spec.source (catalog-spec.md:553).

trust.description: Baseline trust classification. Must come from explicit curation, never from popularity (catalog-spec.md:3385-3400). No policy gate reads it yet.
